title: 第17章 千古一帝惧神仙！
novel_title: 先秦炼气两千年，世人误闯天家
content_zh:
刘彻追问道。

    官员的头，埋得更低了。

    “也……也没有消息。冠军侯和三百绣衣使者，就，消失在了那片大雾之中，再也没有出来过。”

    刘彻的脸色，彻底沉了下来。

    霍去病，是他最信任的将领。

    绣衣使者，是他手中最锋利的刀。

    三百铁骑，足以踏平一个小国。

    现在，竟然，被一片“大雾”，给困住了？

    这怎么可能！

    不祥的预感，开始在他的心中，悄然蔓延。

    难道，淮南那边，真的出了什么，超出他掌控的，惊天变故？

    又过了五天。

    依旧，没有任何消息。

    整个长安城，都开始流传起，各种各样的，小道消息。

    有人说，冠军侯在淮南，遭遇了前楚国贵族的埋伏，全军覆没了。

    有人说，淮南王根本没死，他其实是个妖怪，把冠军侯和绣衣使者，都给吃了。

    流言蜚语，愈演愈烈。

    朝堂之上，也是人心惶惶。

    一名大将的失踪，对于军心士气的打击，是巨大的。

    刘彻终于，坐不住了。

    他再次下令，派遣一支由五千名精锐羽林军组成的队伍，由老将程不识率领，携带各种军中器械，再次前往淮南。

    这一次，他的命令，只有一个。

    不惜一切代价，也要给朕，冲进那片大雾，搞清楚，里面，到底发生了什么！

    然而，这一次的结果，依旧，让人失望。

    十天后，程不识派人传回了消息。

    他们的大军，同样，被挡在了那片，方圆百里的，灰色雾气之外。

    那雾气，有生命，无论他们用什么方法，都无法驱散。

    强行闯入的士兵，无一例外，都在短时间内，昏迷倒地，甚至，七窍流血而亡。

    他们，根本无法，靠近那片区域的核心。

    消息传回长安，朝野震动。

    所有人都意识到，淮南，出大事了。

    出的，是他们，完全无法理解的，天大的事！

    未央宫内。

    刘彻听着程不识派人带回来的，详细禀报，脸色阴沉得，能滴出水来。

    他手中，捏着一块，从那片灰色雾气边缘，带回来的，石头。

    那石头，通体焦黑，表面光滑如镜，却又坚硬无比。

    军中的工匠，用最锋利的百炼钢刀去砍，连一道白印，都留不下。

    “这……就是，那片区域的，地面？”
content_en:
Liu Che asked.

    The official's head was buried lower.

    "There's... no news either. The champion and the three hundred embroidered cloth messengers just disappeared into the heavy fog and never came out again."

    Liu Che's face completely darkened.

    Huo Qubing was his most trusted general.

    The Embroidered Clothes Messenger is the sharpest knife in his hand.

    Three hundred cavalry are enough to flatten a small country.

    Now, unexpectedly, I am trapped in a "heavy fog"?

    How is this possible!

    An ominous premonition began to quietly spread in his heart.

    Could it be that something really happened in Huainan, a shocking change that was beyond his control?

    Another five days passed.

    Still, no news.

    All kinds of gossip began to spread throughout Chang'an City.

    Some people say that Champion Hou was ambushed by the nobles of the former Chu State in Huainan, and his entire army was wiped out.

    Some people say that King Huainan is not dead at all. He is actually a monster who ate the champion and the embroidered messenger.

    The rumors became more and more intense.

    Above the court, people were also in panic.

    The disappearance of a general has a huge impact on the morale and morale of the military.

    Liu Che finally couldn't sit still.

    He once again ordered to send a team of 5,000 elite Yulin troops, led by veteran general Cheng Bushi, carrying various military equipment to Huainan again.

    This time, his order was only one.

    No matter what the cost, you must rush into that heavy fog and figure out what is going on inside!

    However, the result this time was still disappointing.

    Ten days later, Cheng Bushi sent someone to send back the news.

    Their army was also blocked by the gray mist that covered a hundred miles in radius.

    That mist is alive, and no matter what methods they use, they can't dispel it.

    The soldiers who forced their way in, without exception, fell unconscious within a short period of time, or even bled to death.

    They simply couldn't get close to the core of that area.

    The news spread back to Chang'an, and the government and the public were shocked.

    Everyone realized that something big had happened in Huainan.

    What happened was a huge thing that they couldn't understand at all!

    Inside Weiyang Palace.

    Liu Che's face was so gloomy that he could shed tears as he listened to the detailed report Cheng Bushi sent back.

    In his hand, he held a stone that he had brought back from the edge of the gray mist.

    The stone was completely burnt black, its surface was as smooth as a mirror, but it was extremely hard.

    The craftsmen in the army used the sharpest hundred-smelted steel knives to cut it, but not even a white mark was left.

    "This...is the ground in that area?"
title_en: Chapter 17 An emperor throughout the ages is afraid of gods!
